jurisdiction_name: NFLD VILL WARD B (NORTHFIELD VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Nfld Vill Ward B (Village of Northfield Village) has 539 registered voters, with 57.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.1%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.0 percentage points.
